body:

## Reproduction rules for each FAIL

### `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity` · acceptance[3] — stale spec

Clause: "after the org switch chunk PUT / complete / progress → 409".

1. Admin (real form sign-in) starts a chunked upload; a second organization is provisioned (stock single-org refuses `POST /auth/organization/create` 403 ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED, so via system write), then `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/set-active` to it.
2. Chunk PUT → 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT ("This upload was started in a different organization…"); complete → 409; **progress → 200** (expected by the clause: 409). With an expiry stamp due, progress → 409.

§5 disposition: **stale spec** — both sides act on their declarations: the progress door (#22218, `storage-routes.ts`) deliberately keeps answering the uploader from any organization when there is nothing to stamp. Re-point: "chunk PUT and complete → 409; progress → 200 unless an expiry stamp is due (→ 409)". No pin asserts the door-level org-switch 409; it was driven by hand.
